name: Gaines County, TX
findings: Gaines County has 20 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Gaines County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Gaines County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
